label: Every efficient cause of a thing's esse causes it here and now
paraphrase: OPEN analyst tense bridge, attribution deferred: for all c and x, if c is an efficient cause of x's esse (EfficientlyCausesEsse, tenseless), then c is, here and now, an efficient cause of x at the esse respect in the secunda via's sense (EfficientlyCausesIn, DEF-EFFICIENT-CAUSING). It says that every agent cause of esse is a present, conserving cause; a merely originating agent of esse falsifies it (TenseGapControl). It bears on the conservation question of #1604/#1616 and is not derived here.
